segments.ja373:1.1: Kuhiṃ gatā kattha gatā, iti lālappatī jano;
segments.ja373:2.1: Yañcetaṃ [yathetaṃ (pī.), yavetaṃ (ka.), yametaṃ (katthaci)] iti cīti ca, gadrabhova nivattasi;
segments.ja373:3.1: Daharo cāsi dummedha, paṭhamuppattiko [paṭhamuppattito (sī. pī.)] susu;
segments.ja373:3.3: Dīghañcetaṃ [dīghametaṃ (pī.)] samāsajja [samāpajja (syā. ka.)], na te dassāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja373:5.3: Sabbassa atthaṃ jāneyya, na ca sabbaṃ payojaye;
segments.ja373:5.5: Hoti tādisako kālo, yattha atthāvahaṃ sutanti.
